note: heldout_tree_sha is `git rev-parse HEAD:benchmark/tasks/heldout` - the content hash of the sealed split. It is checked by scripts/check_heldout_seal.py on every `make check`. content_commit is the last commit that modified the split. Editing any file under benchmark/tasks/heldout/ changes the tree hash and fails the check. Do not update this file to make the check pass.
